claim: The hub-tests check runs pytest on tests/ from the hub directory, in parallel by file with a 300-second per-test thread timeout, with a 3600-second check timeout.

citations.quote: | 5 | `hub-tests` | `cd hub && py -3.11 -m pytest tests/ -q -n auto --dist loadfile --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread -p no:cacheprovider` | 3600 | 20 min (8875 passed, 0 failed) |
